rooms.name: Mine Entrance
rooms.description: Splintered support beams and a broken winch. The tunnel mouth reeks of tallow smoke - someone's still using this place.

rooms.name: Collapsed Tunnel
rooms.description: Half the ceiling came down here long ago. A narrow path winds around the rubble.

rooms.name: Miners' Cage
rooms.description: The missing crew, alive but starved, penned behind a makeshift iron gate. A single bandit dozes at his post.

rooms.name: Boss Chamber
rooms.description: A wide chamber lit by a stolen brazier. This is where whoever is behind this has been living off the miners' labor.
